'''Pla'atoh''' was a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a shop on the [[Promenade]], where he sold medium armor.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pla'atoh was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears on Nar Shaddaa as an medium armor vendor.
